title: crumbkit/skills-check/v1
description: Whether each skills directory holds the skill that the binary embeds: current, linked, missing, differs or unreadable.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

CheckRow.description:
One skills directory, or several that resolve to the same place, and
whether it holds the binary's skill.

dirs.description: The skills directories that share this copy, as named. Directories that resolve to one place through a symbolic link share one copy.

path.description: The SKILL.md file that was checked, at its real path.

reason.description: Why the copy is missing a file, differs, cannot be read or is linked, such as `written by shelf 0.2.0`, `REFERENCE.md is missing` or `linked to /src/shelf/skill`, or null.

state.description: Whether the copy is the binary's: missing, differs, unreadable, linked or current.

Checked.description: Whether a skills directory holds the binary's skill.

oneOf.description: The directory holds no copy of the skill.
The directory holds a copy that differs from the binary's.

The skill's folder is a symbolic link to a folder that install did
not write, which install skips.
